title: P3.4-M shabu seized, 2 arrested in Zamboanga drug sting

blocks.text: PAGADIAN CITY, Zamboanga del Sur – Two high-value drug suspects were arrested after yielding around 500 grams of suspected shabu valued at P3.4 million in a buy-bust operation in Barangay Lunzuran, Zamboanga City, on Tuesday afternoon, October 13. The Philippine Drug Enforcement Agency – Region 9 (PDEA-9) identified the suspects through their aliases as “Abdurahman,” 50, a resident of Jolo, Sulu, and “Madzrimel,” 38, residing in Barangay Mercedes, Zamboanga City. According to PDEA-9, joint law enforcement units staged the sting operation at around 4:24 p.m., leading to the immediate apprehension of the two suspects.
